title: Reconstruction of the Initial Condition for a Non-Homogeneous Heat Equation from Finite Measurements
summary: We address the inverse problem of reconstructing the initial temperature distribution in a one-dimensional non-homogeneous heat equation with Dirichlet boundary conditions from a finite number of pointwise-in-time measurements at a single spatial location. We propose an explicit approximation scheme that incorporates the source term and utilizes a refined sequence of measurement times. Unlike previous approaches that often rely on exponentially growing observation times, our chosen time sequence allows for efficient recovery within a fixed time horizon.
